title: feat(nm2yzrdn2): distance-2 read of yz-plane cyclic-frame holonomy at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: 2A yz squares, DISTANCE-2 read (translate by 2 lattice units). The band's only readout knob that actually discriminates: on the identical reverse square where 7574/7588/7591/7600 read HOLD under neighbor-read, distance-2 reads FAIL. Verified independently.
